maker_comment:
Hey Product Hunt community! 👋 I'm Chaman Shah, Principal AI Systems Architect at Elesium.

Over the last 18 months, our engineering team has deployed production-grade multi-agent systems for mid-market and enterprise firms across India, the US, and Europe.

Here is the brutal reality of enterprise AI in 2026: 80% of companies are hemorrhaging capital trying to patch together brittle Zapier wrappers and generic conversational chatbots. The moment transaction volumes surge or invoice formats drift, those systems fail silently, generating massive API bills and zero operational ROI.

We built the Enterprise AI ROI Calculator directly into our public engineering platform to give CFOs and CTOs an unvarnished, mathematical evaluation of agentic automation.

🧮 What the calculator computes in 60 seconds:
1. Net Annual Savings: Models manual analyst hours eliminated across underwriting, invoice parsing, and logistics manifests.
2. Payback Period (Months): Compares initial VPC deployment capital against monthly labor savings and error penalty cuts.
3. 3-Year TCO Comparison: Visualizes deterministic LangGraph private VPC hosting versus cumulative multi-tenant SaaS fees.
4. CFO Investment Memo: Instantly generates a clean, downloadable business case summary for executive approval.

It is 100% free with zero paywalls or mandatory sign-ups:
👉 Test the live calculator: https://elesium.online/tools/enterprise-ai-roi-calculator
👉 Embed it on your own blog or docs: https://elesium.online/embed/roi-calculator
👉 Explore our open architectural blueprints: https://elesium.online/solutions

I will be here all day answering deep technical questions on deterministic state machines, private VPC open-weights LLMs, and real-world deployment telemetry. Let's discuss in the comments below!
